resolution.question: Will Rustam's escalated warranty claim for a failed washing machine get a decision from the manufacturer's second-line team within the ten working days quoted in yesterday's email?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the manufacturer's second-line team actually communicated a decision on Rustam's warranty claim before the end of the ten working days (i.e., by 2026-08-17T23:59:59+05:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff (2026-08-19T18:00:00+05:00) if no decision has been communicated by then.
